english.title: Act as flight crew of aircraft without ensuring operator aware of flight times during 28 days preceding flight
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) acted as a member of the flight crew of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom which was

(A)_[flying on a public transport flight,]_
(B)_[operated by the holder of a national air operator's certificate,]_
(C)_[a helicopter flying on a commercial air transport operation,]_
(D)_[an aeroplane with a flight crew of one pilot flying for the purpose of commercial air transport,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), without first ensuring that the operator of the aircraft was aware of your flight times during the period of 28 days preceding the flight
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 176(2) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
